propositions: The rebar-brainstorm skill documentation lacks explicit guidance that a blocked/not-yet-claimable ticket has successfully completed the current review cycle and requires no further agent action until rebar ready resurfaces it

Agents are incorrectly using rebar review-plan --force to bypass the claimability fast-fail on blocked tickets based on vague instructions, when --force is intended only as a human-operator escape hatch
The skill documentation must prohibit review-plan --force as an agent move and direct agents to ask a clarifying question instead of inferring authorization to force
Forced reviews of blocked tickets create signed attestations against non-final dependencies that silently go stale, collectively defeating the plan-review gate even when individually plausible
